whySynergy.headline: Why families choose Synergy.

r1.title: We Work For You, Not One Carrier
r1.body: We're not tied to a single company, so no one carrier decides what your family is offered. We shop multiple top-rated carriers side by side and bring back the plan that fits your budget and your life — not the one that's easiest to sell.

r2.title: Clear, Honest, No Pressure
r2.body: We take an education-first approach to every conversation. Your advisor explains how each option works — in plain English — before recommending anything, so every decision you make is informed, confident, and entirely yours.

r3.title: A Partner for Life
r3.body: We don't disappear after the sale. Your advisor stays with your family through every policy review, every life change, and every new chapter — so your coverage keeps up with the life it protects.

r4.title: ITIN-Friendly, No SSN Required
r4.body: You don't need a Social Security Number to protect your family or build a tax-free retirement plan. We specialize in ITIN coverage for the self-employed workers, construction workers, nurses, and truck drivers the traditional system overlooks.

r5.title: English & Spanish
r5.body: Insurance is complicated enough in your first language. Work through every option with a licensed advisor in the language your family speaks best — English or Spanish — so nothing important gets lost in translation.

r6.title: Licensed in All 50 States
r6.body: From our Orlando office we serve families coast to coast, with the same clarity and care in every state. Wherever life takes you, your coverage — and your advisor — go with you.

r7.title: Built for the Overlooked
r7.body: The traditional system was never built for people who work for themselves or work with their hands. We build coverage and tax-free retirement plans for the workers who keep everything running — and got passed over anyway.

r8.title: Your Advisor, Start to Finish
r8.body: The licensed advisor you speak with on day one is the one who builds your plan, walks you through it, and handles your case for as long as you hold it. No handoffs, no call centers, no starting over.
